fact: Zambia's Ministry of Community Development and Social Services began disbursing more than K1.4 billion in the July-August 2026 Social Cash Transfer cycle to over 1.5 million households, redeemable through beneficiaries' payment service providers, with recipients told to safeguard SIM cards, phones and PINs.

The Smart Zambia Institute's procurement notice says the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project will support upgrading ZamPay from person-to-government payments into an integrated government-to-people (G2P) platform.
Co-Develop says Zambia has rolled out the OpenG2P platform to manage government-to-person payments.

AgriTech Insights, reporting a University of Zambia study, says the government's electronic Farmer Input Support Programme delivers input subsidies to small-scale farmers in Chongwe District through a digital voucher system redeemed at private agro-dealers.
